en: Black‑and‑white street scene of an urban square with buses, trams, cars and cyclists. Multi‑storey residential buildings line the background, and a tree‑filled square sits in the middle. In the foreground is a round kiosk topped with an advertising mast featuring planes and the word "FLYG". Text along the bottom identifies the location as Malmö, Värnhemstorget and Kungsgatan, and credits a photographer from Malmö.
